waves.name: PLAYER_READ_FOUNDATION
waves.why_here: Lowest-risk read-only Player/Hero projection; no schema prerequisite and highest value for a coherent authenticated player surface.
waves.collision_risk: MEDIUM at future route wiring; no direct candidate app.py collision.
waves.stack_policy: Import B028 before B030; do not cherry-pick B030 alone. Import A024/B029 documentation independently.
waves.owner_gate: GO_MERGE required for the future integration candidate; A025-R1 requires a separate Owner PASS before transport/route adoption.
post_merge_verification: no World/Quest/Shop fields in Player API

waves.name: CANONICAL_ACQUISITION_FOUNDATION
waves.why_here: Creates the common committed-acquisition envelope before producer and Shop wiring, without adding a new persistence authority.
waves.collision_risk: LOW for contract import; MEDIUM when producer adapters enter app.py.
waves.stack_policy: Import D018 first; import D019 only after its Owner review and exact D018 lineage are included.
post_merge_verification: adapter fail-closed checks after D019 acceptance

waves.name: EQUIPMENT_INVARIANT_PREPARATION
waves.why_here: Equipment is the product-loop bridge from acquisition to combat, but route centralization must wait for truthful invariant evidence.
waves.collision_risk: HIGH because legacy player_appearance writers and player_inventory equip writers coexist.
waves.stack_policy: Import B031 evidence first; hold B032 design until Owner review, then implement its schema and writer gates as a separate authorized task.
waves.owner_gate: GO_MERGE for evidence; a separate schema/runtime Owner gate before enforcing canonical_slot.

waves.name: COMMERCE_OFFER_AND_PURCHASE_FOUNDATION
waves.why_here: Shop purchase exactly-once semantics are required for the Coins -> item loop, but C019 has a candidate-only operation schema and no route wiring.
waves.stack_policy: Reconcile C019's exact behavior and operation migration onto current master; use C020 as offer evidence; import C021 only after Owner review.
waves.owner_gate: GO_MERGE plus explicit migration review; no Production migration is implied.
post_merge_verification: no route cutover until operation migration is governed

waves.name: WORLD_MONSTER_BOUNDARY
waves.why_here: The boundary contract is current-master-based and prevents Battlefield Boss, Lord, Monster, and World progression authority from collapsing.
waves.collision_risk: HIGH because future wiring crosses adventure_boss, Map Battle, Monster settlement, and World progression.
waves.stack_policy: Import the complete F012 boundary series, not the R1 commit in isolation; hold F013 until Owner review.
waves.owner_gate: GO_MERGE for the pure contract; Owner decision required before any World milestone storage/runtime cutover.
post_merge_verification: no milestone mutation from boundary transport

waves.name: SINGLE_OWNER_APP_PY_RUNTIME_WIRING_AND_COMBINED_ACCEPTANCE
waves.why_here: The listed candidates are mostly pure modules/docs; coherent product behavior requires one Lane E executor to wire them into existing app.py boundaries after prerequisites are accepted.
waves.collision_risk: VERY_HIGH; this is the only wave allowed to modify overlapping app.py regions, and it must be staged internally.
waves.owner_gate: A new explicit GO_MERGE for each authorized implementation candidate; GO_DEPLOY and feature enable remain separate.
post_merge_verification: Production remains untouched until separately gated

stacked_candidate_policy.B028_B030: A: integrate B028 foundation first, then transplant B030 read service onto current master.
stacked_candidate_policy.A025_R1: C: keep pending; after Owner PASS, rebuild the transport/API candidate on current master using B028/B030 outputs rather than importing the old-base chain blindly.
stacked_candidate_policy.D018_D019_R1: A: integrate D018 first, then import/reconcile D019 adapter commits against the current producer result shape.
stacked_candidate_policy.F012_R1: B: import the reviewed F012 base plus R1 as one controlled pure-contract unit; the R1 commit alone is not self-contained.
stacked_candidate_policy.B032_R1: A: documentation can follow its design base, but schema/runtime implementation must be a new current-master task.
stacked_candidate_policy.C021_R1: C: after Owner PASS, transplant the adapter onto current C019/C020 contracts; do not treat its old-base stack as a merge source.
stacked_candidate_policy.D019_R1: A: include D018 before the producer adapter; do not merge the child alone.

next_app_py_integration.reason: B028 and B030 are accepted read-only foundations, A024 is documentation-only, no schema is required, and the route can be kept read-only. This has lower collision risk than Equipment, Shop, Acquisition, or World/Monster mutation wiring and gives the largest immediate player-facing coherence gain.
preconditions: B028 and B030 exact behavior reconciled on current master
A025-R1 Owner PASS or an explicit replacement route contract
no World/Quest/Shop/Premium authority added to the read route
